data.name: Shivtej
data.gender_notes: Shivtej is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shiv Tej is a name that is derived from the combination of two words - 'Shiv' and 'Tej'. 'Shiv' is the name of the Hindu god of destruction and is considered the supreme god of the Hindu pantheon. 'Tej' means 'victory' or 'power'. Therefore, Shiv Tej can be interpreted as 'Shiva's Victory' or 'Shiva's Power'. The name Shivtej carries the meaning “Shiva's Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shivtej usually hope their child will grow to embody shiva's victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shiv Tej is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It signifies the victory of the divine over the mundane and the triumph of spirituality over materialism. It is also a name that is believed to bestow the bearer with the blessings of Lord Shiva and the strength and power to overcome any obstacle in life.
data.etymology: Shivtej belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shiva's Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivtej total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name Shiv Tej serves as a constant reminder of the power and grace of the divine, and the potential within ourselves to triumph over our challenges.
